claude.label: Claude Code
claude.description: Claude Code with git and a terminal. Only Anthropic's API is reachable.

claude-browser.label: Claude Code + browser
claude-browser.description: Adds a headless Chromium in the sandbox (Playwright MCP), so Claude can open and look at web pages. It may only open the sites listed in policies/browser.yaml.

claude-hyperframes.label: Claude Code + HyperFrames
claude-hyperframes.description: Videos from HTML: the browser image plus the HyperFrames CLI, FFmpeg, fonts and the HyperFrames skills. The CDNs and fonts compositions load are allowed, read-only.

opencode.label: OpenCode
opencode.description: OpenCode with models through OpenRouter, with git and a terminal.
